The component renders with no theme provided, which is the cause: in v4 the core makeStyles fell back to a default theme, but @mui/styles in v5 doesn't. I'm settling on the makeStyles option: passing a defaultTheme so it matches v4's behaviour without touching the test or the app's theme.
